headline: MD simulations map GPCR activation, G protein coupling, and allosteric modulator effects
label: Gpcr Activation Dynamics
summary: Experimental class A GPCR structures and GLP-1R and GCR1 simulations now resolve ligand-driven activation pathways that were previously inferred only…
synthesis: The common thread is ligand-driven conformational control of GPCR activation, examined through complementary routes: a machine learning analysis of experimental class A GPCR structures, and molecular dynamics with enhanced sampling. The preprint reports a hybrid mechanism in which ligand binding follows conformational selection. The published GCR1 study proposes, from MD and metadynamics, that abscisic acid binding closes the GPA1 G protein, trapping GDP and blocking nucleotide exchange. The GLP-1R study uses MD and enhanced sampling to show how an ago-allosteric modulator stabilizes active receptor conformations and identifies two intermediate activation states. What is new is the extension of mechanistic simulation from human receptors to a plant GPCR-G protein pair, alongside database-scale structural inference of activation pathways.
